attack.name: Bladework
attack.description: Combat accuracy with stab, slash and block weapons.

strength.name: Might
strength.description: Melee damage output — how hard you hit.

defence.name: Warding
defence.description: Damage reduction and the chance to dodge incoming attacks.

hitpoints.name: Vitality
hitpoints.description: Your health pool. When it hits zero you respawn with penalties.

ranged.name: Marksmanship
ranged.description: Accuracy and damage with bows and thrown weapons.

magic.name: Sorcery
magic.description: Rune-based spell damage, effects and utility.

prayer.name: Devotion
prayer.description: Activate rites that buff combat, at the cost of Devotion points per attack.

slayer.name: Huntsman
slayer.description: Assign monster tasks for slayer points, rewards and combat bonuses.

corruption.name: Blight
corruption.description: Abyssal pact magic — trade safety and sanity for raw power.

woodcutting.name: Timbercraft
woodcutting.description: Chop trees for logs, the base material for many crafts.

fishing.name: Angling
fishing.description: Catch fish from rivers, lakes and the sea.

mining.name: Delving
mining.description: Quarry ores, stones and gems from veins.

farming.name: Husbandry
farming.description: Plant seeds into your farm plots; crops grow over real time and are harvested for XP. Seeds come from thieving drops; compost from the settlement trader.

firemaking.name: Kilncraft
firemaking.description: Burn logs into charcoal, ash and kindling.

cooking.name: Cookery
cooking.description: Turn raw fish and ingredients into cooked meals that restore health.

smithing.name: Forgecraft
smithing.description: Smelt bars and forge them into armour and weapons.

fletching.name: Bowyering
fletching.description: Craft arrow shafts, arrows and bows from logs and feathers.

crafting.name: Artifice
crafting.description: Work leather, cloth and gems into armour, jewellery and accessories.

runecrafting.name: Glyphcraft
runecrafting.description: Bind elemental runes for magic spells and enchantments.

herblore.name: Apothecary
herblore.description: Brew potions and combat consumables from herbs and reagents.

thieving.name: Larceny
thieving.description: Pick pockets and lift goods from NPCs and stalls.

agility.name: Wayfaring
agility.description: Run obstacle courses to earn agility points and passive bonuses.

summoning.name: Beastbinding
summoning.description: Craft tablets and summon familiars that aid you in combat and skilling.

astrology.name: Starreading
astrology.description: Study constellations to grant skill and combat bonuses.

alt_magic.name: Runescribing

actions.name: Superheat Iron
actions.description: Melt iron ore straight into a bar with a breath of air magic.

actions.name: Ward of Vigor
actions.description: Weave a ward that makes food heal for more.

actions.name: Bone Offering
actions.description: Offer bones to the earth for insight; sometimes the ground gives back pure essence.

actions.name: Enchant Gold Ring
actions.description: Charm a plain gold ring into a Ring of Prospecting.

actions.name: Conjure Coal
actions.description: Press earth and fire together into coal for the forge.

actions.name: Superheat Steel
actions.description: Fold carbon into iron with fire instead of coal.

actions.name: Low Alchemy
actions.description: Turn a gold ring into coin.

actions.name: Enchant Sapphire Ring
actions.description: Bind water magic into a sapphire ring, sharpening mastery.

actions.name: Ward of Insight
actions.description: Weave a ward that quickens all skill learning.

actions.name: Superheat Silver
actions.description: Melt silver ore into a bar.

actions.name: Superheat Gold
actions.description: Melt gold ore into a bar, ready for jewelry.

actions.name: Transmute Sapphire
actions.description: Recolour two topazes into one sapphire.

actions.name: Enchant Emerald Ring
actions.description: Bind nature magic into an emerald ring, quickening every skill.

actions.name: Big Bone Offering
actions.description: A heavier offering; the earth occasionally answers with prismatic essence.

actions.name: High Alchemy
actions.description: Turn a sapphire ring into coin.

actions.name: Ward of Fortune
actions.description: Weave a ward that draws more gold to you.

actions.name: Superheat Mithril
actions.description: Melt mithril ore into a bar without coal.

actions.name: Enchant Topaz Ring
actions.description: Bind a hawk's eye into a topaz ring for archers.

actions.name: Ward of Stone
actions.description: Weave a ward that blunts every blow you take.

actions.name: Superheat Adamantite
actions.description: Melt adamantite ore into a bar without coal.

actions.name: Enchant Ruby Ring
actions.description: Bind fire into a ruby ring for fighters.

actions.name: Transmute Ruby
actions.description: Fuse two emeralds into one ruby.

actions.name: Grand Alchemy
actions.description: Turn a ruby ring into coin.

actions.name: Dragon Bone Offering
actions.description: A dragon's bones carry old power; now and then they leave umbral essence behind.

actions.name: Ward of Fury
actions.description: Weave a ward that makes every style hit harder.

actions.name: Enchant Diamond Ring
actions.description: Bind a protective ward permanently into a diamond ring.

actions.name: Superheat Runite
actions.description: Melt runite ore into a bar without coal.

actions.name: Transmute Diamond
actions.description: Crush two rubies into one diamond.

actions.name: Ward of Plenty
actions.description: Weave a ward that sometimes doubles monster drops.

actions.name: Superheat Dragonite
actions.description: Melt dragonite ore into a bar without coal.

actions.name: Arcane Alchemy
actions.description: Turn a diamond ring into coin.

actions.name: Bind the Riven Signet
actions.description: Rework a warded diamond ring into the frontier's finest signet.

actions.name: Superheat Umbral
actions.description: Melt umbral ore into a bar without coal.

actions.name: Transmute Herald
actions.description: Raise an umbral bar into a herald bar.

actions.name: Superheat Herald
actions.description: Melt herald ore into a bar without coal.

actions.name: Ward of Ascendance
actions.description: The capstone ward: faster skill and mastery learning everywhere.

alt_magic.description: Cast spells with runes: superheat ore, enchant jewelry, transmute materials, alchemize rings into coin and weave timed wards.

township.name: Settlement
township.description: Build and manage a settlement: houses, farms and production.

cartography.name: Surveying
cartography.description: Survey and chart the world's hexes, coasts and waters.

archaeology.name: Excavation
archaeology.description: Excavate dig sites to recover ancient relics and artefacts.

harvesting.name: Prospecting
harvesting.description: Harvest veins, nodes and wild resources from the landscape.

echo_keeping.name: Echo Keeping

actions.name: Kiln Rhythm
actions.description: A working kiln keeps a steady beat. Listen long enough and the beat acquires a shape you can replay.

actions.name: Thread the Rack
actions.description: Push captured traces into a rack in a chosen order. The order is the skill — the sequence is what repeats, not the bonus.

actions.name: Replay the Rack
actions.description: Run the whole sequence again from the top. A rack with no reset eventually stops working at all.

actions.name: Dock Rhythm
actions.description: Ropes and cranes repeat themselves exactly. The dock's impression is loud, regular, and cheap to read.

actions.name: Set Preparation
actions.description: Open a sequence on a preparation trace: it establishes a condition the following actions inherit.

actions.name: Set Repetition
actions.description: Extend the condition and let it fray. More effect, less reliability, every cycle through.

actions.name: Orchard Rhythm
actions.description: A hundred harvests leave a patient layer: slower to read, but it plays back for far longer.

actions.name: Set Interruption
actions.description: Break the run deliberately. Distortion clears, and benefits pause while it does.

actions.name: Set Completion
actions.description: Convert accumulated momentum into a finished cycle: quality, output, or mastery progress.

actions.name: Listen at the Forge
actions.description: The forge's hammer-rhythm leaves deep traces.

actions.name: Inscribe a Craft
actions.description: Bind the arrangement into a finished working, so the rhythm travels with the object instead of the rack.

actions.name: Set a Cadence
actions.description: A steady cadence packs three charges into one arrangement.

actions.name: Perfect Cycle
actions.description: Every stage lands and the sequence resets cleanly, so the result is worth more than its parts.

actions.name: Listen to the Tide Bells
actions.description: The drowned bells ring with old, layered echoes.

actions.name: Flawless Echo
actions.description: No seam anywhere in the sequence. The rack goes quiet because there is nothing left to fix.

actions.name: Inscribe a Masterwork
actions.description: Two inscriptions from one long, careful session.

actions.name: Herald Echo
actions.description: Record the sound the ashfall made and keep it. Play it once, then seal the rack.

actions.name: Listen to the Herald Choir
actions.description: The choir's echoes are dense enough to gather by the handful.

actions.name: First Echo
actions.description: Play back the very first thing the rack ever heard. Everything since was a copy.

actions.name: Keep an Eternal Echo
actions.description: Fold a herald echo into two flawless copies.

echo_keeping.description: Preserve echoes of your actions for later replay and bonuses.

wayfolding.name: Wayfolding

actions.name: Survey a Route
actions.description: Walk the ground and record what passes. Plants run easy along it; stone emphatically does not.

actions.name: Place an Anchor
actions.description: Set a fixed point where a passage may begin. One anchor is only a marker; it takes two to make a door.

actions.name: Survey a Footpath
actions.description: Short paths, quickly walked.

actions.name: Join Two Anchors
actions.description: Draw a passage between two anchored places. Long chains strain; a junction costs a slot but buys flexibility.

actions.name: Survey a Branch
actions.description: A second reading of the same country, in the other direction.

actions.name: Run a Manifest
actions.description: Operate the network for one cycle. Deliveries pay; a branch whose supplies ran dry simply pauses.

actions.name: Place an Anchor Pair
actions.description: Two anchors from one survey — the cheap way to build a network you will actually use.

actions.name: Reinforce a Link
actions.description: Widen a passage so heavier loads use it without tearing the fold.

actions.name: Survey the Cargo
actions.description: Ask what a load actually weighs this month. The answer changes with the season.

actions.name: Tie a Return
actions.description: A way back that carries something different from the way out.

actions.name: Batch Contracts
actions.description: Run the same routes under standing contracts: cheaper per delivery, far less freedom to reroute.

actions.name: Survey the Highway
actions.description: Busy roads map themselves.

actions.name: Conditional Link
actions.description: Let the cargo choose the direction: light out, heavy back, or only while a branch sits idle.

actions.name: Chain Anchors
actions.description: Three links from a single chained line.

actions.name: Condense a Line
actions.description: Fold a whole supply line into an afternoon. The ceiling of the skill, in a single action.

actions.name: Write an Express Manifest
actions.description: Fast freight, four manifests at a time.

actions.name: Grand Confluence
actions.description: Every road in the survey arriving at once, politely, in a single afternoon.

actions.name: Survey the Skyroad
actions.description: High routes over the Riven Frontier.

actions.name: Herald Gate
actions.description: Draw a passage to exactly one place and hold it open. Knock first.

actions.name: Bind a Herald Confluence
actions.description: Two confluences from condensed herald routes.

wayfolding.description: Chart routes and place anchors to fast-travel across the world.

fermentation.name: Fermentation

actions.name: Catch Morning Mist
actions.description: Take the air before the sun burns it off: a damp, low-energy starter that wants to stay damp.

actions.name: Charge a Vessel
actions.description: Insulate, pressurise and damp a vessel around one starter. The vessel decides what the culture may become.

actions.name: Feed the Culture
actions.description: Materials from other skills push the culture toward a known range. Feeding the same thing twice is not the same as feeding it well.

actions.name: Catch Hillside Wind
actions.description: Dry, quick and hungry — a poor friend to seedlings and a good one to anything being cured.

actions.name: Charge a Vessel Pair
actions.description: Two vessels at once, for lineages you intend to cross later.

actions.name: Mature to Schedule
actions.description: Hold the vessel at a chosen endpoint rather than chasing a number. Predictable, and a little slower.

actions.name: Harvest a Charge
actions.description: Release the weather and start a fresh lineage. A bad batch still returns something usable.

actions.name: Catch Greenhouse Warmth
actions.description: Borrowed heat, held against glass: persistent, gentle, and slow to change its mind.

actions.name: Feed Toward Dry
actions.description: Strip the humidity out: harder conditions, shorter-lived results, and far better for processing.

actions.name: Catch Orchard Bloom
actions.description: Blossom-heavy air starts cultures well.

actions.name: Retain the Culture
actions.description: Release slowly and keep the vessel charged. Less weather per batch, but the next one inherits everything you learned.

actions.name: Steep a Culture
actions.description: A long steep yields three matured cultures.

actions.name: Bottle a Charge
actions.description: Bottle the charge before it fades.

actions.name: Cross-Culture
actions.description: Two lineages in one vessel. The result depends on which company it keeps.

actions.name: Catch a Storm Front
actions.description: A passing storm, caught in jars.

actions.name: Release a Programme
actions.description: Mist, then warmth, then dry wind: a scheduled sequence of climates released as one job.

actions.name: Grand Vintage
actions.description: A weather kept a decade too long. It pours like a decision.

actions.name: Catch the Aurora
actions.description: Cold, bright, and very potent.

actions.name: Herald Cask
actions.description: Sealed against the ashfall. Whatever is inside has finished becoming.

actions.name: Halcyon Vintage
actions.description: Open the cask on the calmest day of the year. There is exactly one.

fermentation.description: Ferment resources into potent brews and concentrates.

customcraft.name: Customcraft

actions.name: Propose a Custom
actions.description: Notice what a settlement wastes, or plainly lacks, and write down the habit that would fix it.

actions.name: Provision the Practice
actions.description: Bring materials and tools for the first night. Nothing is free; you fund every round until the habit funds itself.

actions.name: Run the Practice
actions.description: Attend, again and again. Participation is the real resource; the materials are only the excuse for it.

actions.name: Propose a Harvest Fair
actions.description: Everyone likes a fair.

actions.name: Provision a Feast
actions.description: Feed the gathering, twice over.

actions.name: Archive a Custom
actions.description: Retire a custom at a modest fee and fold what it taught into a standing record. A bad habit should cost a detour, not a playthrough.

actions.name: Propose a Festival
actions.description: A bigger interruption than a habit. Once established it divides attention rather than stacking with rivals.

actions.name: Invite the Neighbours
actions.description: Draw in people who had better things to do. More attendance, and more competition for the same attention.

actions.name: Establish the Custom
actions.description: A settlement now runs its own routine. The benefit continues without you standing there.

actions.name: Pair Two Customs
actions.description: Seed exchanges feed kitchens; kitchens feed repair nights. Paired customs do more than the sum of their parts.

actions.name: Propose a Pageant
actions.description: A pageant draws proposals from the whole town.

actions.name: Rehearse a Tradition
actions.description: Practice makes a tradition.

actions.name: Regional Variant
actions.description: The same tradition adapted to somewhere else: salt by the sea, smoke inland, and different inputs for each.

actions.name: Codify a Custom
actions.description: Write it down and it lasts.

actions.name: Living Legend
actions.description: A tradition still being told by the person it happened to. Handle with care.

actions.name: Crown a Tradition
actions.description: A paired custom grows into legend.

actions.name: Herald Craft
actions.description: Made the way it will be remembered, which is to say perfectly.

actions.name: Myth Knit
actions.description: Weave every telling together until the seams stop showing. Then wear it.

customcraft.description: Propose and run customs — community traditions with unique rewards.

lostfinding.name: Lostfinding

actions.name: Accept a Case
actions.description: Take a commission with a stated reward range and a handful of certain facts. You are choosing here, not rolling.

actions.name: Broad Search
actions.description: Sweep everywhere plausible. Cheap per lead, unreliable, and it costs supplies to do.

actions.name: Interview a Witness
actions.description: People are reliable about time and unreliable about objects. The window narrows every time.

actions.name: Recover the Object
actions.description: Follow the chain home. Confidence decides how cleanly this ends more than the dice do.

actions.name: Targeted Search
actions.description: Spend the time and the materials to look in exactly one place. Fewer possibilities, far better odds.

actions.name: Inspect Cargo Records
actions.description: A ledger neither lies nor knows. It tells you which carriage carried it, or that none did.

actions.name: Canvass the Market
actions.description: Ask every stall; someone saw something.

actions.name: Accept an Urgent Case
actions.description: Better pay, worse odds, a shorter window. The stated range is honest about the risk.

actions.name: Close the File
actions.description: Tie off the whole chain and file the record; solving one disappearance explains the next.

actions.name: Press a Label
actions.description: Restore a damaged shipping mark. The document itself becomes the evidence.

actions.name: Return an Heirloom
actions.description: The good kind of case: a family, a museum, and something that unlocks how you work.

actions.name: Echo Lens
actions.description: See repeated handling: which hands, how many, in what order. The newest instrument in the trade.

actions.name: Accept Cold Cases
actions.description: Old files nobody else will touch.

actions.name: Cold Trail
actions.description: A trail years old and still warm at the edges. Follow it quietly and do not hurry the end.

actions.name: Reconstruct a Timeline
actions.description: Evidence alone can rebuild the day.

actions.name: Herald Case
actions.description: Closed. The label is in your handwriting and you have never seen it before.

actions.name: Paper Ghost
actions.description: Find the file investigating you back. It was filed under your own name.

actions.name: Archive Ash
actions.description: File everything, burn the archive, and keep the one page that matters.

lostfinding.description: Take on lost-item cases, search broadly, and recover what was misplaced.

ranching.name: Husbandry
ranching.description: Raise pens of animals for produce, hides and manure over real time.

inscription.name: Scribing
inscription.description: Scribe paper and ink into quality texts, equippable tomes and active glyphs.

engineering.name: Engineering
engineering.description: Install automated devices that work fuel and materials into output over time.

enchanting.name: Attunement

actions.name: Study Minor Attunement
actions.description: Practice attunement; recycle gear and apply enchantments.

actions.name: Attune Worked Iron
actions.description: Draw martial essence out of worked iron.

actions.name: Attune Tanned Leather
actions.description: Leather that turned blows gives up warding essence.

actions.name: Study Keen Attunement
actions.description: Practice attunement; recycle gear and apply enchantments.

actions.name: Attune Living Wood
actions.description: Fresh-cut oak still carries verdant essence.

actions.name: Study Tempered Attunement
actions.description: Practice attunement; recycle gear and apply enchantments.

actions.name: Attune Tempered Steel
actions.description: Steel holds twice the martial charge of iron.

actions.name: Study Runic Attunement
actions.description: Practice attunement; recycle gear and apply enchantments.

actions.name: Attune Wyrmhide
actions.description: Dragonhide is warding essence made solid.

actions.name: Attune Yew Heartwood
actions.description: Old yew is thick with verdant essence.

actions.name: Study Ancient Attunement
actions.description: Practice attunement; recycle gear and apply enchantments.

actions.name: Split Prismatic Essence
actions.description: Break prismatic essence into its arcane parts.

actions.name: Attune Stormsteel
actions.description: Stormsteel is the richest martial source there is.

actions.name: Study Celestial Attunement
actions.description: Practice attunement; recycle gear and apply enchantments.

enchanting.description: Disenchant unwanted gear into typed essence and enchant individual equipment pieces.

dreamwalking.name: Dreamwalking
dreamwalking.description: Allocate offline time to dreams for essence, events and the Dream Bazaar.
